title: iPE Titanium Exhaust System – Porsche 911 Turbo S (992.2)
body: iPE Titanium Valvetronic Exhaust for the Porsche 992.2 Turbo S The iPE exhaust system for the Porsche 911 Turbo S (992.2) is now offered as a complete titanium Valvetronic exhaust system . It has been developed specifically for the latest Turbo S and retains valve control through the factory Porsche Sport Exhaust (PSE) controls. At launch, iPE is supplying the 992.2 Turbo S exhaust only as a complete system. Separate muffler and downpipe sections are not currently offered. Customers can choose between a 200 CPSI catted full system and a catless full system . Available Configurations Full System – Catted – complete titanium Valvetronic exhaust with 200 CPSI high-flow catalytic converters Full System – Catless – complete titanium Valvetronic exhaust without catalytic converters Optional OBD Blocker An optional OBD blocker can be added for applications where suppression of a check-engine light (CEL) is required. The OBD blocker is available as an add-on to either full-system configuration. The OBD blocker does not change the physical exhaust configuration or the road-approval status of the exhaust system. Designed for the Porsche 992.2 Turbo S The latest Porsche 911 Turbo S uses Porsche's T-Hybrid powertrain with twin electrically assisted turbochargers. iPE developed this system specifically around the 992.2 Turbo S rather than carrying over the previous-generation exhaust architecture. The production system is manufactured from titanium and uses extensive heat shielding around critical sections of the exhaust. Catted or Catless The catted full system uses 200 CPSI high-flow catalytic converters , combining increased exhaust flow with retained catalytic converters. The catless full system provides the least restrictive exhaust route and is intended for applications where local legislation permits its use. Key Features Complete titanium exhaust system Developed specifically for the Porsche 911 Turbo S (992.2) iPE Valvetronic exhaust technology Valve control through the factory Porsche Sport Exhaust (PSE) controls Compatible with OPF-equipped Porsche 992.2 Turbo S models Choice of 200 CPSI catted or catless full-system configuration Optional OBD blocker for CEL suppression Vehicle-specific iPE engineering Worldwide supply and fitment support through BaanVelgen Fitment & Compatibility This exhaust system is intended for the Porsche 911 Turbo S (992.2) and is compatible with OPF-equipped vehicles. iPE Valvetronic Exhaust Technology The system retains factory Porsche Sport Exhaust (PSE) valve control . Electronically controlled exhaust valves allow the exhaust character to change between a more refined setting and a significantly more pronounced sound when the valves are open. title: BBS RT88 Forged Wheels for BMW F82 M4 – 20 Inch
body: The BBS RT88 for BMW F82 M4 is offered as a staggered 20-inch set with 9.5 x 20 ET18.55 at the front and 11.0 x 20 ET36.35 at the rear. Both wheels use a 5x120 connection. title: BBS LM Le Mans Wheels for Porsche 911 Carrera 2 / 4 (964) Narrow Body
body: BBS LM Le Mans wheels for the Porsche 911 Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 (964) combine one of the most iconic multi-piece wheel designs in automotive history with a carefully selected 18-inch fitment for the narrow-body, also known as small-body, Porsche 964. Introduced in 1994 and inspired by the BBS racing wheels used at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the BBS LM is particularly well suited to the proportions and character of the air-cooled Porsche 911. Its traditional cross-spoke design, exposed rim bolts and diamond-cut outer rim create a period-correct motorsport appearance without compromising the original design language of the 964. This staggered wheel set combines an 18 x 8.5-inch front wheel with an 18 x 10.0-inch rear wheel, creating a balanced and purposeful stance for narrow-body Porsche 964 Carrera models. Product Highlights Iconic BBS Le Mans cross-spoke design Forged aluminium two-piece construction Staggered 18-inch fitment for the narrow-body Porsche 964 Suitable for Porsche 911 Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 models Original Porsche 5x130 bolt pattern and 71.6 mm centre bore Designed for use with the original Porsche wheel bolts Period-correct motorsport styling for the air-cooled Porsche 911 Manufactured in Japan by BBS Fitment Specifications Front – LM265: 18 x 8.5 ET56 – 5x130 – 71.6 mm centre bore Rear – LM286: 18 x 10.0 ET50 – 5x130 – 71.6 mm centre bore This configuration is intended for the narrow-body or small-body Porsche 911 Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 (964) . It is not intended as the corresponding fitment for wide-body 964 Turbo or Turbo Look models. Replacement wheel bolts are therefore not included unless ordered separately. title: iPE OPF Front Pipe for Lamborghini Urus SE (2025+)
body: The iPE OPF front pipe for the Lamborghini Urus SE is the stainless-steel front-pipe component developed for OPF/GPF-equipped vehicles. It allows the iPE Urus SE exhaust system to be configured around the factory particulate-filter specification and connects the relevant front and rear exhaust sections. Product Specification Vehicle: Lamborghini Urus SE Model year: 2025 and newer Application: OPF/GPF-equipped vehicles Material: stainless steel Product type: vehicle-specific front pipe Complete System Integration The OPF front pipe is intended to be selected as part of a correctly specified Urus SE exhaust configuration. It can be combined with the iPE Urus SE downpipes and the iPE Valvetronic exhaust system . Because production and market specifications may differ, BaanVelgen will verify the complete system before dispatch. Key Benefits Developed specifically for OPF-equipped Lamborghini Urus SE models Stainless-steel construction Designed as part of the modular iPE exhaust system Supports a correctly matched downpipe, front-pipe and rear-muffler configuration Fitment verification and worldwide supply through BaanVelgen Why Order from BaanVelgen? As an official iPE Exhaust distributor, BaanVelgen provides product advice, fitment support, quotations, availability checks and worldwide shipping for Lamborghini performance upgrades. Frequently Asked Questions Do I need this front pipe for every Urus SE? No. The required parts depend on the vehicle’s OPF/GPF specification and the other exhaust components being installed. VIN verification is recommended. Is the front pipe supplied in titanium? The price list supplied for this application specifies the OPF front pipe in stainless steel. Can I order a complete iPE Urus SE system? Yes. Add the required downpipe configuration and Valvetronic rear exhaust, or contact BaanVelgen for a complete vehicle-specific quotation.

title: iPE Catted or Catless Downpipes for Lamborghini Urus SE (2025+)
body: The iPE downpipes for the Lamborghini Urus SE are developed to reduce restriction in the front section of the exhaust and create a stronger, more immediate V8 exhaust character. They are available with 200-cell high-flow sport catalysts or as a catless configuration for maximum exhaust flow. Choose the Correct Downpipe Configuration 200-cell catted downpipes: high-flow catalyst configuration developed for customers who want improved flow while retaining catalytic converters Catless downpipes: unrestricted race configuration intended for off-road or motorsport use where permitted Performance and Sound Replacing the restrictive factory downpipe section can improve exhaust-gas flow and significantly increase sound intensity. The effect is strongest when the downpipes are combined with the iPE Valvetronic exhaust system for the Lamborghini Urus SE . The final result depends on the selected front pipe, rear exhaust, valve position and engine calibration. Key Benefits Vehicle-specific development for the Lamborghini Urus SE Choice of catted or catless construction 200-cell high-flow catalysts in the catted version Reduced exhaust restriction compared with the corresponding factory section More aggressive turbo-V8 sound and improved exhaust response Can be configured with the iPE OPF front pipe and Valvetronic muffler system Fitment and Compatibility For the Lamborghini Urus SE, model year 2025 and newer . Exact compatibility depends on production date, market specification, OPF/GPF equipment, software and the remaining exhaust configuration. Provide your VIN and intended setup before ordering. Why Buy iPE Downpipes from BaanVelgen? BaanVelgen is an official iPE distributor and can verify the complete configuration before supply. We support customers, installers and tuning companies with fitment checks, pricing, availability and worldwide shipping. Frequently Asked Questions What is the difference between catted and catless downpipes? Catted downpipes retain high-flow sport catalysts. Catless downpipes remove the catalytic elements for maximum flow and sound, but are generally unsuitable for public-road use. Do I need an ECU tune? A tune may be required, particularly with catless downpipes. Requirements depend on the vehicle software, catalyst monitoring and complete exhaust configuration. Consult an experienced Lamborghini tuner before installation. Can these downpipes be combined with the iPE rear exhaust? Yes, they are offered as part of the modular iPE Urus SE exhaust range. BaanVelgen recommends verifying the complete combination, including the OPF front pipe , before ordering. Are catless downpipes road legal? In most jurisdictions, removing catalytic converters is not legal for public-road use. Local legislation always takes precedence.

title: iPE Valvetronic Exhaust System for Lamborghini Urus SE (2025+)
body: The iPE Valvetronic Exhaust System for the Lamborghini Urus SE is developed for owners who want to restore the emotional V8 character of Lamborghini’s plug-in hybrid Super SUV without sacrificing everyday usability. This vehicle-specific rear muffler system uses switchable exhaust valves to create a clear contrast between a more restrained closed-valve sound and a deeper, more aggressive open-valve tone. Choose between a T304 stainless-steel system and a lightweight Grade 1 titanium system . Each configuration is supplied with iPE 3D-printed exhaust tips in silver, with black and gold tip finishes available as premium options. Available Configurations T304 stainless steel: durable construction and a powerful, refined exhaust character Grade 1 titanium: premium lightweight construction with a sharper and more exotic sound profile 3D-printed silver tips: included as standard 3D-printed black or gold tips: optional premium finishes Sound and Valve Control The Urus SE combines a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with plug-in hybrid technology. The iPE Valvetronic system is engineered to make the combustion engine feel more present and engaging whenever the driver wants it. With the valves closed, the system is intended to remain more suitable for daily driving and longer journeys. With the valves open, exhaust flow and sound intensity increase for a more dramatic Lamborghini experience. Complete iPE Urus SE Exhaust Configuration This listing covers the Valvetronic rear muffler system and selected 3D-printed tips . For a more complete exhaust upgrade, combine it with the iPE catted or catless downpipes for the Lamborghini Urus SE and the iPE OPF front pipe . BaanVelgen can confirm which combination is suitable for your exact vehicle and market specification. title: Novitec NF8 Directional Forged Wheels - Ferrari 296 GTB & GTS
body: The Novitec NF8 Directional Forged wheels for the Ferrari 296 GTB and Ferrari 296 GTS . Their distinctive directional design, lightweight forged construction and vehicle-specific dimensions give the Ferrari 296 a sharper stance while preserving the precision expected from a modern Ferrari supercar. Manufactured by Vossen exclusively for Novitec , the NF8 is not a conventional wheel design repeated four times. Each wheel is individually engineered for its exact position on the vehicle: front left, front right, rear left and rear right. This ensures that the directional spokes rotate in the intended visual and aerodynamic direction on every corner of the car. Available in 20"/21", 21"/21" and 21"/22" staggered configurations , the NF8 can be specified for an OEM-inspired appearance, a balanced performance setup or maximum visual impact. Four Corner-Specific Directional Wheels The defining feature of the Novitec NF8 is its true directional construction. Many directional-style wheels use the same wheel design on both sides of the vehicle, causing the spokes to face forwards on one side and backwards on the other. Novitec and Vossen developed the NF8 differently. A separate wheel is manufactured for every position on the Ferrari 296, allowing the five pairs of spokes to follow the same direction of rotation on both sides of the car. This creates a balanced and technically correct appearance from every angle. The angled spoke geometry is also designed to guide airflow through the wheel area and support ventilation around the braking system. Key Features Designed for the Ferrari 296 GTB and Ferrari 296 GTS True directional design with a different wheel for each corner Manufactured by Vossen exclusively for Novitec Forged monoblock aluminium construction Five twin-spoke directional wheel design Vehicle-specific widths, offsets and load specifications Engineered for compatibility with the Ferrari braking system Available in multiple staggered diameter combinations Wide selection of solid, brushed, polished and transparent finishes Made to order for the individual vehicle Available Ferrari 296 Fitments The Novitec NF8 is available in three different configurations. Each setup offers a different balance between ride quality, steering response and visual presence. 20"/21" Performance Configuration Front wheels: 9.5J x 20" Rear wheels: 11.5J x 21" Recommended front tyres: 255/35 R20 Recommended rear tyres: 325/25 R21 The 20"/21" combination maintains additional tyre sidewall at the front axle. It is the most understated NF8 configuration and an excellent choice for owners who prioritise steering feel, road usability and an appearance closer to the original Ferrari proportions. 21"/21" Balanced OEM+ Configuration Front wheels: 9.5J x 21" Rear wheels: 11.5J x 21" Recommended front tyres: 255/30 R21 Recommended rear tyres: 325/25 R21 The equal-diameter 21"/21" setup creates a more contemporary and visually balanced profile. title: BBS CH-R II "satin black" // 21 inch
body: Two-piece in the summer - The CH-R II Wheel design raised the CH-R to a new level With the two-piece wheel design CH-R II , the Schiltach-based premium manufacturer BBS raises its classic and proven CH-R to a new level, and is thus in an excellent position for the summer. The two-piece design of the wheel allows for previously unknown perspectives. For decades, demanding customers and car manufacturers have relied on light alloy wheels made by BBS. No design embodies the values of the Schiltach traditional brand in this context as much as the famous premium wheel CH-R. At the Geneva Motor Show, BBS now presents the completely revised two-piece variant CH-R II. The structure of the wheel with a wheel well and a separate star hubs for the front and rear axles opens special design options for the consumer. The wheel wells of the CH-R II are unique in the industry and make a considerable weight optimization possible. Long, thin spokes and a very small center area give the CH-R design its equally timeless and dynamic appearance. The two-piece CH-R II design combines the design language of the bestseller with the latest technology from motor sport in an optimal way. Like its one-piece counterpart, the CH-R II is also subjected to flow-forming after production in the low-pressure casting process. This high-quality rotary rolling process allows the production of particularly light and strong wheels. In addition, the CH-R II features milled spokes to achieve maximum weight savings without sacrificing structural stability. The proven BBS collision protection and a laser inscription in the star hub provide for additional enhancement of the wheel. The wheel well of the CH-R II is available in the color satin titanium , the star hub in satin black , and can be ordered in 21 inch in sizes 9x21, 9.5x21, 10x21, 10.5x21 and 11x21 inches. Available for Audi, Porsche and BMW About BBS: BBS is the world's most well-known brand for light alloy wheels. title: BBS CH-R // 20 inch
body: Size: 20x10.5 ET25 PDC 5x112 – All around Finish: Matt Black Matt Antracite Bright Silver Design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Technology Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Separating from its sister, the CH, the back milled spokes provide greater weight and strength optimization. Specific features The CH-R wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. The stainless rim protector can easily be changed in case of damage and provides an ideal way to make your rims look like new again or personalize.

Racing has established itself as a leader in the world's light alloy wheel industry. O.Z. Racing produces standard equipment wheels for some of the most exclusive automobiles in the world including Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and Lotus. The Italian company also fills the needs of prestigious automotive equipment and bodywork companies like Bertone, Pininfarina, AMG, Hartge, Callaway, Schnitzer, Cizeta, Strosek and Giugiaro. A look inside the high technology design and manufacturing facilities of Ruote O.Z. Racing s.p.a. in Italy will unveil what it takes to create an O.Z. Racing wheel that is a winner on the highway and the race track. Each stage of production focuses on creating a stronger, more beautiful wheel and this commitment has earned them more titles in motorsports than any other brand, including Indy 500/IRL, LeMans Series and Formula 1 Grand Prix wins as well as World Rally Championships and more. O.Z. Racing never compromises on quality and complies with all official regulations of their client countries, including the stringent rules of T.U.V., the German control office. O.Z. Racing constantly submits their wheels to multiple comprehensive testing to measure road stress. And to detect minute flaws, wheels are put under pressure in a specially designed water tank and scanned for hidden flaws by X-ray. Further examination is done by computer and electron microscopes. Finally, an anti-corrosion treatment is given, followed by a protective lacquer coating and final cleaning. A Lap on the Nurburgring O.Z.'s pursuit of excellence is not limited to advanced manufacturing processes; every O.Z. wheel design is taken for simulated laps on the famous Nurburgring circuit. This is done with a biaxial test machine. The test simulation standard is guaranteed via a license released by the German research institute LBF Fraunhofer and is the most complete and the closest simulation of the harshest conditions wheels may experience. The machine simulates the radial forces, the axial forces, the accelerations, the decelerations and the road surface variations that the wheels would experience on the Nurburgring circuit for 22,000 miles. Even if not necessary for homologation purposes, O.Z. uses the experience acquired through the daily use of this machine to develop and further improve its wheels O.Z. Racing wheels — the combination of elegant design, the latest manufacturing technology and scientific precision creating a winning harmony between the beauty of form and the quality of function that is the trademark of O.Z. title: Ultraleggera HLT CL Center Lock
body: The OZ ultraleggera centerlock wheel, the ideal upgrade for your Porsche 991 and 997 with centerlock application. The ultraleggera is the most well-known 6 double-spoke wheel ever! Ultraleggera HLT is known and recognized as one of the most popular OZ wheels. The wheel design is Formula 1 race-inspired. Its racing DNA is apparent in several details: the spokes are slim and extend all the way out to the external lip, the center is carved out, just like on racing wheels. Thanks to the application of HLT technology, the wheel acquires mechanical features quite similar to those of a forged wheel, ensuring that two critical objectives have been achieved – weight reduction and strength. The Central Lock version is designed for Porsche GT2, GT3 and Turbo owners.

title: BBS CH-R // 20 inch
body: Size: 20x8.5 ET40 PDC 5x112 – All around Finish: Matt Black Matt Antracite Bright Silver Design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Technology Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Separating from its sister, the CH, the back milled spokes provide greater weight and strength optimization. Specific features The CH-R wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. The stainless rim protector can easily be changed in case of damage and provides an ideal way to make your rims look like new again or personalize.

title: Brixton Forged FDE02 Magnesium+
body: Brixton Forged FDE02 Magnesium+ wheels. Introducing the Brixton Forged FDE02 Magnesium wheel line – forged from MagnesiumAZ80. Revolutionizing performance and style for sports and supercars. The wheels are crafted from AZ80 Forged Magnesium and treated with an anti-oxidation coating.Brixton Forged FDE02 Magnesium+ wheels are 1.5 times lighter than aluminum. The significant lower weight and therefor unsprung weight delivers a quicker acceleration, sharper handling, quicker braking, and better fuel efficiency. Besides that Magnesium offers 50 times the dampening power of aluminum for an exceptionally smooth ride. Designed for peak performance, these wheels set a new standard in both function and aesthetics. Engineered for track excellence, the Brixton Forged MAGNESIUM+™ Series wheels weigh from 15.6 lbs (7.2kg) in a 20 x 9 -inch size, providing a 30% weight reduction compared to aluminum and surpassing OEM magnesium wheels in performance. Magnesium’s finer hexagonal grain structure and lower density contribute to their remarkable lightness, reducing unsprung mass and significantly enhancing vehicle handling and responsiveness. TheBrixton Forged FDE02 are CNC-milled forged magnesium wheels and produced through a precise process involving high-grade alloys, forging for strength, CNC milling for exact dimensions, and heat treatment for enhanced hardness. They are finished with an anti-oxidation coating and rigorously tested for safety and performance. Unlike their competitors, these wheels are available in a wide range of styles and sizes, from 18-21″, tailored specifically for sports and supercar applications, ensuring exceptional strength, lightweight performance, and advanced design. Standard on all the Brixton MAGNESIUM+ wheels, bead-seat knurling is crucial for race wheels as it enhances the grip between the tire and the rim, reducing the risk of slippage under high stress. This knurling creates a textured surface that helps secure the tire bead in place, ensuring stable and reliable performance, especially during high-speed cornering and acceleration. Proper bead seat knurling improves safety and control, which are essential for achieving peak performance in competitive racing. Add the unique text & Groove Fill, brand logo, text, and groove color fill options to your wheel set. Available in black, grey, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. The price is for a set of 4 wheels.

title: MR magnesium wheels Porsche 991 GT3 RS
body: MR magnesium wheels for the Porsche 991 GT3 RS and GT2 RS . The Manthey Racing wheels will give a total weigh reduction of an impressive 12.6kg. Available in 9.5 x 20 ET50 and 12.5 x 21 ET48, in Brilliant Silver, Satin Black, Titanium or Gold. For the new wheel set suitable for the Porsche 991 GT3 RS Manthey Racing is using the design and technology being used in the Porsche 991 RSR which they raced in the season 2015 and won the WEC world championship. Their aim was to transform the technology from the race track to the street. Using the material Magnesium MR was able to drop the weight dramatically and save ±13kg compared to the original wheel set in similar size. The specific weight is 7.0 kg for the 9,5 x 20 offset 50 front and 9.5 kg for the 12,5 x 21 offset 48. The finishes we have available are Brilliant Silver, Satin Black, Titanium or Gold. We can also have them custom finished in basically any color, please contact us if you are interested in a custom finish. You will receive 4 wheels, 2 pieces for front BBS RE1640 9,5x20 ET50 GT3 RS mec 2 pieces for rear BBS RE1641 12,5x21 ET48 GT3 RS mec These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM standard Tires or a set of 265/35-20 and 325/30/21s, with the option of the following tire brand/models: Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 N (Porsche Spec) (Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on Porsche GT3 RS) Pirelli Trofeo R (The Stickest Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on the McLaren P1, and many other Hypercars) Other tyre brands and the Michelin CUP R and prices upon request

title: Brixton Forged PF14-RS
body: Brixton Forged PF14-RS wheels. The Brixton PF14-RS is a weight optimized 1-piece monoblock forged wheel suited as a performance upgrade for supercars. The RS-Series is a fusion of motorsport, engineering, and design all in one package. The series is a response to the question “What would we get if we utilized topological optimization, traditional FEA, and our own passion for design?”. The Brixton team dug into their CAD library and pulled out the top selling designs and applied the same formula, optimize + test + refine. The goal was to ultimately shave weight, and design a structurally optimized wheel with flawless surface transitions that is as artistic as it is technical. The result has been a series of wheels that follow the Brixton Forged ethos design leadership, ingenuity, and quality. Its our way of saying “they’re light, they’re new, they’re unique, and they look damn good”. Add the unique text & Groove Fill, add brand logo, text, and groove color fill options to your wheel set. Available in black, grey, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.

body: Vossen HF5 The Vossen HF5 wheel is the all-new Hybrid Forged™ design. The HF5, is derived from its forged counterpart, the S21-01. With pocketed spokes and an aggressive modern Y-pattern design. The standard finishes are matte gunmetal and gloss black. The Vossen HF5 Hybrid Forged is available in three different concave profiles. Flat, Deep and Super Deep concave profiles allow for extremely aggressive fitments for a wide range of makes and models. Available in 19", 20", 21", 22", 23" and 24" inch and in a wide variety of optional finishes. Satin or matte black, gloss gold, satin or gloss silver, satin or matte bronze or anthracite. On the images shown on a Tesla Model 3 and BMW 3-series g20, since the wheels are partly custom made they can be made for almost every make and model. Available Vossen Forged Finishes Vossen Forged wheels are available in a wide range of solid and transparent finishes, including gloss, satin, matte, textured, brushed and polished options. title: Brixton Forged JO01 Jon Olsson
body: Brixton Forged JO01 Jon Olsson wheels. The Brixton Forged JO01 wheel is multi-piece that incorporates the Brixton Forged PF7 wheel design. Brixton added several design components, 3D printed turbo-fans, vented aero rings, and custom milled motorsport CL caps with PCD covers. The results is an incredible wheel designed for Jon Olsson his “Leon the RS6”, the latest addition to his fleet, it is a 1000hp Audi RS6 tuned and built by Stertman Motorsport in Sweden. As Brixton began the Audi RS6 collaboration between Brixton Forged and C’est Normal / Jon Olsson, they went into it with the idea to build something truly unique that was different from the usual wheels that is created. This was a more modern take on the wheel that was recently created with Bisimoto and his electric Kremer K3 Porche 935 that stole the spotlight at Sema Show in 2019.

title: Brixton R11-R Duo Series
body: Brixton R11-R Duo Series wheels. The Brixton R11-R duo wheel is a detailed 10-spoke design with the R for race, making them extra light. The Brixton Forged 2-Piece Duo Series has a lightweight mono-center profile which is designed to increase dynamic cornering response, acceleration, and decrease overall stopping distance Each wheel set is tailored to be the most optimal combination of lightweight forging profiles and surface milling features. The duoblock wheels give the opportunity to make a wider wheel then the 1-piece wheels, and offer the deepest concave wheels in any width. Every Duoblock Series wheel set is individually designed and engineered specifically for each clients performance supercar, sedan or SUV. This ensures that every set has the best possible fitment, concavity and performance for your driving style. Each wheel set is built from scratch specifically for your vehicle and driving needs.

title: Brixton R11-R Targa Series
body: Brixton R11-R Targa Series wheels. The Brixton R11-R 3-piece wheel is a detailed 10-spoke design. The Brixton Forged Targa Series is a combination of the technical engineering of the lightweight monoblock wheel with a 3-piece super deep concave construction. The Targa Series features weight reduction floated spoke ends, lightweight step lip rim halves and backpad pocketing; all of which are designed to increase dynamic cornering response, acceleration, and decrease overall stopping distance. title: Brixton R11-R ULTRASPORT+
body: Brixton R11-R ULTRASPORT+ wheels. The Brixton R11-R forged wheel is a ultrathin 10-spoke design with a lot of detailing and weight saving. It is milled from aerospace grade aluminum, the forged 6061-T6. The Brixton Forged 1-Piece Ultrasport+ Series is the definition of lightweight forged wheels Each wheel set is tailored to be the most optimal combination of lightweight forging profiles and surface milling features, with the deepest concave possible. The ultralow weight results in even better driving and handling of your car. It increases dynamic cornering response, acceleration, and decreasing overall stopping distances. Every 1-piece Ultrasport+ Series wheel set is individually designed and engineered specifically for each clients performance supercar, sedan or SUV. This ensures that every set has the best possible fitment, concavity and performance for your driving style, please specify if you will be using the wheels on road and/or for track use. Each wheel set is built from scratch specifically for your vehicle and driving needs.

title: Vossen HF3
body: Vossen HF3 wheels - Hybrid Forged. The HF-3 sports the classic split 5 spoke design but with Vossens touch of design with unique beveling in each spoke and around the lug hole area. The Vossen HF-3 comes in two unique finishes with the popular Double Tinted Gloss Black and their luxurious Gloss Graphite Polished finish. The Vossen HF-3 wheels is available in three different concave profiles. Flat, Deep and Super Deep concave profiles allow for extremely aggressive fitments for a wide range of makes and models. Vossen HF3 wheels is a hybrid forged wheel, with this process the rim well of the cast blank is rolled out over a die with heat and pressure. The result is greater strength with a thinner wall and higher load capacities. This production technique makes it possible to reduce volume and weight in the rim well. Available in 19", 20", 21", 22" and 24 inch and 9 optional finishes. Gloss, satin or matte black, gloss gold, satin or gloss silver, satin or matte bronze or anthracite. Available Vossen Forged Finishes Vossen Forged wheels are available in a wide range of solid and transparent finishes, including gloss, satin, matte, textured, brushed and polished options. View the complete Vossen finish guide

The Brixton Forged 1-Piece Ultrasport+ Series is the definition of lightweight forged wheels Each wheel set is tailored to be the most optimal combination of lightweight forging profiles and surface milling features, with the deepest concave possible. The ultralow weight results in even better driving and handling of your car. It increases dynamic cornering response, acceleration, and decreasing overall stopping distances. Every 1-piece Ultrasport+ Series wheel set is individually designed and engineered specifically for each clients performance supercar, sedan or SUV. This ensures that every set has the best possible fitment, concavity and performance for your driving style, please specify if you will be using the wheels on road and/or for track use. Each wheel set is built from scratch specifically for your vehicle and driving needs.

title: HRE P107SC
body: HRE P107SC is their latest 2019 wheel design. The design is a split-5-spoke design , and HRE took them to the next level by introducing additional aggressive design features. To create a more dynamic design language on the P107SC, particular attention was given to spoke intersection points and the outer lip surface. These areas further reduce mass but also increase visual interest to create the latest in HRE Forged wheel design. The HRE Series P1SC is the latest evolution of their best-selling Series P1. HRE started with the same philosophy of combining purposeful lightweight design with track-focused optimization. With purposeful I-Beam structures on all spoke sides and efficient lug bolt pockets, HRE was able to increase spoke stiffness while further reducing mass and thereby the unsprung weight of your car. The wheels are available in 19", 20", 21", 22" and 23 inch, they are custom build and therefor available for basicly every car. Here the P107SC is shown in the Frozen Dark Clear finish and in satin black on the Ferrari 488 GTB.

title: MR magnesium wheels Porsche 991 GT3 20 inch
body: MR magnesium wheels for the Porsche 991 GT3 in 20 inch for 991.1 and 991.2 . The Manthey Racing come in 9x20 ET52 and 12x20 ET44, in the finishes gold, satin black or platinum silver. Due to the fact that these are forged Magnesium, these are extremely light. For the new wheel set suitable for the Porsche 991 GT3 Manthey Racing is using the design and technology being used in the Porsche 991 RSR which they raced in the season 2015 and won the WEC world championship. Their aim was to transform the technology from the race track to the street. Using the material Magnesium, MR was able to drop the weight dramatically and save a lot of weight. The specific weight is 6.78 kg for the 9x20 ET52 in front and 8.43 kg for the 12x20 ET44. The finishes we have available are gold, satin black or platinum silver. We can also have them custom finished in basically any color, please contact us if you are interested in a custom finish. You will receive 4 wheels, 2 pieces for front BBS RE1757 9x20 ET52 GT3 mec 2 pieces for rear BBS RE1758 12x20 ET44 GT3 mec These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM standard Tires or a set of 245/35-20 and 305/30/20s, with the option of the following tire brand/models: - Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 N (Porsche Spec) (Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on Porsche GT3 RS) - Pirelli Trofeo R (The Stickest Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on the McLaren P1, and many other Hypercars) - Other tyre brands and models such as the Michelin CUP R upon request

title: HRE 540 Series
body: HRE 540 wheels is one of the most iconic wheel styles HRE has ever created . The 540 Series quickly became one of HRE’s hottest sellers on cars like the E46 M3, Porsche 996 Turbo and C5 Corvette. To commemorate with the 40th Anniversary in 2018, they’ve revived just the 540 mesh style, re-engineering it to work with today’s most exclusive sports cars and SUVs, bringing a little bit of the 90’s back to enjoy. The result is a better 540 ready to take on the next 20 years. Featuring a classic mesh design and is available in three styles. With its competitive pricing it is the ideal upgrade for any car. Here the wheels are shown on a BMW F80 M3 , but as these are custom made to order, they are available for all vehicles, even the smaller SUV's like Porsche Macan. Available in 17", 18", 19", 20", 21", 22" and 24"

title: Vossen RS74 for Porsche 991 GT3
body: Vossen RS74 for Porsche 991 GT3 Vossen and Champion motorsport teamed up and developed the ultimate Porsche wheel, the result is the forged ultralight RS74. A classic Y-spoke, which make it possible to make a strong and lightweight wheel. Available in centerlock for the porsche 991 GT3, both MK1 and MK2. Note an original styling element of the RS74 is showing the exposed centering pins. This allows Vossen to offer deeper cuts in the Forged 6061-T6 aluminum. The RS74 has less weight with a distinct look without sacrificing strength. For the 991 GT3 the wheels come in a 9.0 x 20 inch and 12.0 x 20 inch, available in 48 colors. These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM Tires or a set of 245/35-20 and 305/30/20s, with the option of the following tire brand/models: - Michelin Pilot Sport 4S N (Porsche Spec) (Michelin's Latest MAX Performance Tire using Michelin Total Performance Technology) - Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 N (Porsche Spec) (Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on Porsche GT3 991.1) - Pirelli Trofeo R (The Stickest Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on the McLaren P1, and many other Hypercars) - Other tyre brands and prices upon request Available Vossen Forged Finishes Vossen Forged wheels are available in a wide range of solid and transparent finishes, including gloss, satin, matte, textured, brushed and polished options. View the complete Vossen finish guide

title: HRE R101LW Lamborghini Huracan Performante
body: The HRE R101LW Lightweight motorsport wheels for the Lamborghini Huracan Performante in 20 inch, the forged y-spoke wheel features a concave design. The R101LW is designed specifically for the grueling environment of today's race tracks where added strength and lightweight design is of the utmost importance HRE's Motorsport Collection combines the technical expertise from our championship-winning racing wheels with an uncompromised attention to detail creating the ultimate in lightweight, high-strength performance forged wheels. The R1 Motorsport series is the ideal wheel for people who attend trackdays and desire a featherlight wheel. These HRE R101LW wheels in 20 inch and optional 21 inch rear wheel are specificically designed for the Lamborghini Huracan Performante with an extremely low weight of 8,07kg of the front wheels, 9,07 kg for the rear wheel and 10,06 for the optional 21 inch rear wheel. This model has a specific load rating and power output, each model application of this design is fine-tuned in each detail of the wheel to remove weight and add stiffness where possible, another standard option is the knurling on tire bead seat, helping to prevent tire slippage in extreme motorsport situations.

title: ANRKY Wheels | AN39 Three Series
body: ANRKY Wheels, AN39 Three Series. The AN39 design features a 15-spoke wheel with elegantly thin and contoured evenly spaced out spokes, the original take on this multispoke design seems to consist of 5 tridents. THREE SERIES: The Three Series configuration of ANRKY Wheels offers their designs in a 3-piece construction . In this configuration the spokes appear to be floating within the lip, while they actually connect to the assembly flange further inwards. SPECIFICATIONS: These wheels are custom made to order, so there are many possibilities available besides the configuration: 3-Piece forged construction with contoured center disc 6061-T6 Heat treated forged aluminum Available in 20, 21, 22 & 24" diameters (with 19" following in the near future) Available in widths from 4.5 to 15.5"+ 50/50, exposed or hidden hardware Titanium ARP hardware optional Custom finishing Vehicle load / G.A.W.R. specific Engineered, machined, fiinshed & assembled in the U.S.A. N-SERIES: The N-Series configuration of ANRKY Wheels offers their designs in a 2-piece construction . In this configuration the spokes are extended all the way to edge of the lip, creating a monoblock look at the outer edges while mainting the assembly flange further inwards. SPECIFICATIONS: These wheels are custom made to order, so there are many possibilities available besides the configuration: 2-Piece forged construction with contoured center disc 6061-T6 Heat treated forged aluminum Available in 20, 21 & 22" diameters (with 19" following in the near future) Available in widths from 4 to 14" 50/50, exposed or hidden hardware Titanium ARP hardware optional Custom finishing Vehicle load / G.A.W.R. specific Engineered, machined, fiinshed & assembled in the U.S.A. The wheels are custom made to order, they are available for all vehicles including center lock applications.

title: Vorsteiner Competition Series VCS 002
body: The Vorsteiner Competition Series VCS 002 aluminum bespoke wheels are made using the latest T-6061 aerospace grade aluminum blocks and individually machined to your exact standards. These wheels are lightweight and load rated for your specific vehicle to maximize weight efficiency and performance. We also offer a virtually unlimited selection of custom finishes, only limited by your imagination. The forged monoblock Vorsteiner Competition Series VCS 002 wheels feature an innovative split-5 spoke design with advanced face pocketing for a modern appearance and reduce unnecessary weight. The R1 motorsport series is the ideal wheel for people who attend trackdays and desire a featherlight wheel. These HRE R101LW wheels in 19 inch are specificically design for the BMW F82 M4 and F80 M3 with an extremely low weight of 7,57kg of the front wheels and 7,98 kg for the rear wheel. title: Ultraleggera HLT CL Center Lock colors
body: The OZ ultraleggera centerlock wheel, the ideal upgrade for your Porsche 991 and 997 with centerlock application. The full range of colors is now available in this centrallock application. The wheel design is Formula 1 race-inspired. Its racing DNA is apparent in several details: the spokes are slim and extend all the way out to the external lip, the center is carved out, just like on racing wheels. The colors we have are: Matt Bronze, Gloss Black, Race White, Race Gold, Orange, Matt Red, Acid Green, Matt Race Silver Thanks to the application of HLT technology, the wheel acquires mechanical features quite similar to those of a forged wheel, ensuring that two critical objectives have been achieved – weight reduction and strength. The Central Lock version is designed for Porsche GT2, GT3 and Turbo owners.

The R101LW is designed specifically for the grueling environment of today’s race tracks where added strength and lightweight design is of the utmost importance HRE’s Motorsport Collection combines the technical expertise from our championship-winning racing wheels with an uncompromised attention to detail creating the ultimate in lightweight, high-strength performance forged wheels. The R1 motorsport series is the ideal wheel for people who attend trackdays and desire a featherlight wheel. These HRE R101LW wheels in 20 inch are specificically design for the Porsche 997 widebody with an extremely low weight of 7,34kg of the front wheels and 8,84 kg for the rear wheel. This model has a specific load rating and power output, each model application of this design is fine-tuned in each detail of the wheel to remove weight and add stiffness where possible, another standard option is the knurling on tire bead seat, helping to prevent tire slippage in extreme motorsport situations.

title: BBS FI-R Forged Wheels for Porsche 991 Wide Body
body: BBS FI-R forged wheels for the Porsche 911 Type 991 wide-body models combine forged monoblock construction with the distinctive weight-relief milling that defines the FI-R design. The wide-body Porsche 991 application pairs the common FI-R 144 front wheel with the wider-offset FI-R 146 rear. This configuration is intended for 991 variants with the wider rear body and must not be confused with the ET62 narrow-body rear application. Why choose BBS FI-R? Forged aluminium monoblock construction for high strength and reduced mass Weight-relief milling removes material from low-load areas of the spokes Reduced rotating and unsprung mass supports steering and suspension response Official BBS Motorsport vehicle application Genuine BBS Motorsport product supplied by BaanVelgen Wheel specifications for Porsche 911 Type 991 wide-body models Position BBS reference Item number Size Offset Connection Front FI-R 144 1618165 9.0 x 20 ET48 5x130 Rear FI-R 146 1618167 11.5 x 20 ET46 5x130 Configuration: 20-inch staggered set. Mounting: 5x130. The dimensions above are listed in the supplied 2026 BBS Motorsport FI-R application list. BaanVelgen still verifies the exact model, brake package, suspension and tyre configuration before accepting the order. Available finishes Current BaanVelgen FI-R finish options for this product include: Satin Black Platinum Silver Satin Bronze Finish availability can change by wheel reference. Metallic colours can also appear different under studio lighting, daylight and calibrated or uncalibrated screens. What is included? This product is configured as a complete set of four wheels. The set uses the front and rear BBS references stated in the table above. Racing produces standard equipment wheels for some of the most exclusive automobiles in the world including Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and Lotus. The Italian company also fills the needs of prestigious automotive equipment and bodywork companies like Bertone, Pininfarina, AMG, Hartge, Callaway, Schnitzer, Cizeta, Strosek and Giugiaro. A look inside the high technology design and manufacturing facilities of Ruote O.Z. Racing s.p.a. in Italy will unveil what it takes to create an O.Z. Racing wheel that is a winner on the highway and the race track. Each stage of production focuses on creating a stronger, more beautiful wheel and this commitment has earned them more titles in motorsports than any other brand, including Indy 500/IRL, LeMans Series and Formula 1 Grand Prix wins as well as World Rally Championships and more. O.Z. Racing never compromises on quality and complies with all official regulations of their client countries, including the stringent rules of T.U.V., the German control office. O.Z. Racing constantly submits their wheels to multiple comprehensive testing to measure road stress. And to detect minute flaws, wheels are put under pressure in a specially designed water tank and scanned for hidden flaws by X-ray. Further examination is done by computer and electron microscopes. Finally, an anti-corrosion treatment is given, followed by a protective lacquer coating and final cleaning. A Lap on the Nurburgring O.Z.'s pursuit of excellence is not limited to advanced manufacturing processes; every O.Z. wheel design is taken for simulated laps on the famous Nurburgring circuit. This is done with a biaxial test machine. The test simulation standard is guaranteed via a license released by the German research institute LBF Fraunhofer and is the most complete and the closest simulation of the harshest conditions wheels may experience. title: BBS CH-R  // 19 inch
body: Size: 19×8.5 ET32 PCD5x120 – Front 19×9.5 ET35 PCD5x120 – Rear Finish: Matt Black Matt Antracite Bright Silver Design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Technology Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Separating from its sister, the CH, the back milled spokes provide greater weight and strength optimization. Specific features The CH-R wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. The stainless rim protector can easily be changed in case of damage and provides an ideal way to make your rims look like new again or personalize.

title: BBS E88 Motorsport
body: Exceedingly strong and light; the BBS E88 wheels for your track or race vehicle are the choice when coming in first is the priority. Available in various widths (most in half inch increments) and all cars, such as BMW M3, M4, Porsche 997, Porsche 991. They are the ultimate 3-piece modular wheels. Made from a proprietary BBS forged aluminum alloy for improved strength and lower weight than even their Magnesium counterparts. BBS Motorsport quality ensures they are the choice to take all the track can dish out. BBS got its start in the 1970s when it began producing wheels for touring car racing. It quickly became a widely recognized name in the world of motorsports because of its ability to produce race-winning wheels that compromised neither integrity nor weight . The Vorsteiner VFN501 Steplip wheels are made using the latest T-6061 aerospace grade aluminum blocks and individually machined to your exact standards. These 3-piece wheels are lightweight and load rated for your specific vehicle to maximize weight efficiency and performance. We also offer a virtually unlimited selection of custom finishes, only limited by your imagination. The 3-piece steplip consists of a three-piece construction, created with the deep concave profile forgings with a modified die designed to allow what is called a “contoured spoke” extension. This feature allows to engineer each set with spokes specifically following the exact contour of the step lip surface resulting in a look unlike any other wheel and performance to match. Back Pad Pocketing is applied to every wheel to shave off any weight that isn't required for structural integrity, keeping the weight of the wheels as low as possible. These wheels are compatible with the factory Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) of your vehicle and all designs are rigorously tested to exceed safety standards.

title: Alleggerita HLT
body: Model: Monobloc wheel HLT Design: 9 spokes design Hubcap: Black carbon fibre hubcap Finishing: Matt Graphit Silver, White, Matt Black, Titanium Tech, Orange, Matt Blue, Race Gold or Red Dimensions: 18 Production process: Low Pressure Casting Process + Heat Treatment + HLT Materials: Al Si 7 Mg About OZ Racing wheels Since creating its first wheels in 1971, O.Z. Racing has established itself as a leader in the world's light alloy wheel industry. O.Z. Racing produces standard equipment wheels for some of the most exclusive automobiles in the world including Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and Lotus. The Italian company also fills the needs of prestigious automotive equipment and bodywork companies like Bertone, Pininfarina, AMG, Hartge, Callaway, Schnitzer, Cizeta, Strosek and Giugiaro. A look inside the high technology design and manufacturing facilities of Ruote O.Z. Racing s.p.a. in Italy will unveil what it takes to create an O.Z. Racing wheel that is a winner on the highway and the race track. Each stage of production focuses on creating a stronger, more beautiful wheel and this commitment has earned them more titles in motorsports than any other brand, including Indy 500/IRL, LeMans Series and Formula 1 Grand Prix wins as well as World Rally Championships and more. O.Z. Racing never compromises on quality and complies with all official regulations of their client countries, including the stringent rules of T.U.V., the German control office. O.Z. Racing constantly submits their wheels to multiple comprehensive testing to measure road stress. And to detect minute flaws, wheels are put under pressure in a specially designed water tank and scanned for hidden flaws by X-ray. Further examination is done by computer and electron microscopes. Finally, an anti-corrosion treatment is given, followed by a protective lacquer coating and final cleaning. A Lap on the Nurburgring O.Z.'s pursuit of excellence is not limited to advanced manufacturing processes; every O.Z. wheel design is taken for simulated laps on the famous Nurburgring circuit. This is done with a biaxial test machine. The test simulation standard is guaranteed via a license released by the German research institute LBF Fraunhofer and is the most complete and the closest simulation of the harshest conditions wheels may experience. The machine simulates the radial forces, the axial forces, the accelerations, the decelerations and the road surface variations that the wheels would experience on the Nurburgring circuit for 22,000 miles. Even if not necessary for homologation purposes, O.Z. uses the experience acquired through the daily use of this machine to develop and further improve its wheels O.Z. Racing wheels — the combination of elegant design, the latest manufacturing technology and scientific precision creating a winning harmony between the beauty of form and the quality of function that is the trademark of O.Z. Racing.

body: BBS LM Le Mans forged wheels are genuine two-piece forged aluminium wheels with the cross-spoke design derived from BBS racing wheels used at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Introduced in 1994, the LM remains one of the most recognisable forged wheel designs worldwide. This product contains the complete current BBS LM range: 145 official specifications in 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21 inch diameters, combined with eight official finishes. The displayed price is for one individual wheel and already reflects the selected finish premium where applicable. Unsure which BBS LM fits your car? Send BaanVelgen the vehicle make, model, model year, exact version, brake specification and current tyre sizes. We can verify the correct front and rear LM type numbers before you order. Why choose the BBS LM? Select the exact BBS LM type number and specification. Select the required finish. Select the quantity. A complete staggered set normally uses two front and two rear wheels with different LM type numbers. Diameter and bolt pattern alone do not confirm fitment. Offset, centre bore, brake clearance, vehicle load, tyre dimensions, suspension height and body clearance must also be checked. title: OZ Racing Hyper GT
body: The OZ Hyper GT wheel, OZ poured all of its experience in GT3 racing into this wheel design. Quite often, choosing a wheel for one’s car is part of making an aesthetic statement. But they wanted to do something different and extra. So, they created the HyperGT HLT. A new approach to alloy rims, an authentic heir of the world of racing and, specifically, GT racing, in which OZ has set the standard for many years. The HyperGT HLT is a distillation of engineering know-how acquired over decades of design experience, filled with details and technological solutions drawn from racing culture. The resulting wheel expresses the perfect balance between light-weight, rigidity and durability, just as racing wheels have shown us they should be. Indeed, being super light-weight is not enough. When it comes to performance, a series of other parameters that allow the wheel to perform at the highest levels must be taken into consideration. The magic formula for performance is: rigidity, to make the wheel more reactive; light-weight, for better handling and strength to cope with mechanical stresses. When these three elements are perfectly balanced, you achieve the top performance that only HyperGT HLT can ensure.

title: APEX SM-10
body: The APEX SM10 wheel is the latest design from APEX. It has been designed with a curve to provide additional caliper clearance and the special "I" Beam Spokes . These spokes have lowered the weight even more compared the to EC-7. All APEX wheels feature Flow-Formed construction that utilizes rotary forging to produce a strong and lightweight barrel. The SM-10 is no exception and is therefor extremely light and strong. You won’t find tricky terminology to cover up a lack of testing here. At APEX they always do real world crush testing and get real certificates from the Japanese Government again to prove it, just like they’ve always do and as all of the brands we sell. Designed for BMW applications, the wheel accepts TPMS sensors, factory lug bolts or stud conversion kits, and OEM roundel center caps part number: 36 13 1 095 361. All wheels come with APEX center caps.

title: APEX FL-5
body: The APEX FL-5 wheel features a special flowformed front and rear barrel. APEX did this because they needed to produce the strongest front lip possible, and by doing this it is possible to optimize the depth of the front lip for every unique width and offset. The flowforging significantly reduces weight in the barrel, which has the greatest impact on rotational mass. They've produced an even stronger wheel by combining the strength of the lightweight barrel with a more robust face design. The FL-5 welcomes endurance racing and potholes. You won’t find tricky terminology to cover up a lack of testing here. At APEX they always do real world crush testing and get real certificates from the Japanese Government again to prove it, just like they’ve always do and as all of the brands we sell. Designed for BMW applications, the wheel accepts TPMS sensors, factory lug bolts or stud conversion kits, and OEM roundel center caps part number: 36 13 1 095 361. All wheels come with APEX center caps.

title: BBS CH-R II "satin black" // 20 inch
body: Two-piece in the summer - The CH-R II Wheel in 20 inch design raised the CH-R to a new level With the two-piece wheel design CH-R II in satin black in 20 inch fitment, the Schiltach-based premium manufacturer BBS raises its classic and proven CH-R to a new level, and is thus in an excellent position for the summer. The two-piece design of the wheel allows for previously unknown perspectives. For decades, demanding customers and car manufacturers have relied on light alloy wheels made by BBS. No design embodies the values of the Schiltach traditional brand in this context as much as the famous premium wheel CH-R. At the Geneva Motor Show, BBS now presents the completely revised two-piece variant CH-R II. The structure of the wheel with a wheel well and a separate star hubs for the front and rear axles opens special design options for the consumer. The wheel wells of the CH-R II are unique in the industry and make a considerable weight optimization possible. Long, thin spokes and a very small center area give the CH-R design its equally timeless and dynamic appearance. The two-piece CH-R II design combines the design language of the bestseller with the latest technology from motor sport in an optimal way. Like its one-piece counterpart, the CH-R II is also subjected to flow-forming after production in the low-pressure casting process. This high-quality rotary rolling process allows the production of particularly light and strong wheels. In addition, the CH-R II features milled spokes to achieve maximum weight savings without sacrificing structural stability. The proven BBS collision protection and a laser inscription in the star hub provide for additional enhancement of the wheel.

title: BBS CH-R with central lock
body: The BBS CH-R with central lock for Porsche 997 and 991 wide body in 20 inch. The design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Specific features of the BBS CH-R with central lock is that the wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. The stainless rim protector can easily be changed in case of damage and provides an ideal way to make your rims look like new again or personalize.

title: BBS LM-R Forged Wheels – All Sizes & Finishes
body: BBS LM-R forged wheels are genuine two-piece forged aluminium wheels developed as a performance-focused member of the BBS LM family. BBS states that the LM-R uses technology developed for its Porsche Carrera Cup racing wheel, combining low weight, strength and a distinctive open cross-spoke design. This product contains the complete current BBS LM-R range: 35 official specifications in 19, 20 and 21 inch diameters, combined with four official finishes. The displayed price is for one individual wheel . Unsure which BBS LM-R fits your car? Send BaanVelgen the vehicle make, model, model year, exact version, brake specification and current tyre sizes. We can verify the correct front and rear LM-R type numbers before you order. Why choose the BBS LM-R? Genuine BBS two-piece forged aluminium construction Sport-focused design using technology developed for BBS Porsche Carrera Cup racing wheels Available in 19, 20 and 21 inch diameters Official 5x112, 5x114.3, 5x120, 5x130 and 5x132 specifications Exact BBS type number, width, offset, bolt pattern, bore or PFS and wheel weight shown for every option Four official BBS LM-R finish combinations Worldwide delivery and specialist fitment support from BaanVelgen How to order the correct BBS LM-R wheel Select the wheel diameter. Select the exact BBS LM-R type number and specification. Select the required finish. Select the quantity. A complete staggered set normally uses two front and two rear wheels with different LM-R type numbers. Diameter and bolt pattern alone do not confirm fitment. Offset, centre bore, brake clearance, vehicle load, tyre dimensions, suspension height and body clearance must also be checked. BBS also lists vehicle-specific restrictions for some PCD applications, so exact vehicle fitment should be verified before ordering. For pre-configured four-wheel packages, view the BBS forged wheel collection . For fitment assistance, contact BaanVelgen .
